title: the lab checks out LF on every box
intention: CairnCommons/.gitattributes carries 'intentions-congruency-lab/** text eol=lf', so the lab checks out LF on every box and a recompile on a core.autocrlf=true box leaves the tree clean.
why: Measured on yoga 2026-11-16 (2dda7060d84e's live fire, relayed by the orchestrator): with core.autocrlf=true the gate writes the lab LF over a CRLF checkout, leaving 98 of 131 lab files stat-dirty with an empty diff (--ignore-cr-at-eol: 0 changes). Every drain check and dirty=0 gate on a Windows box after a recompile reads dirt that is not real.
traces_to: Law 7 (a diagnostic surface reading phantom dirt is a surface lying) and Law 3 (the drain check measures what is not there).
how: One line in CairnCommons/.gitattributes beside the journal merge-driver line. A red-first proof reads the commons' attributes for a lab path and, in a scratch repo with core.autocrlf=true and the commons' .gitattributes copied in, finds a lab file rewritten LF after a checkout reads clean.

clauses.claim: git check-attr on the commons reports text set and eol lf for a path under intentions-congruency-lab/
in a scratch repo with core.autocrlf=true and the commons' .gitattributes, a committed lab file checked out and rewritten LF leaves git status --porcelain empty
the journal merge-driver attribute still reads merge=cairn-journal for .artifact-journal.jsonl

decisions.text: D1: append 'intentions-congruency-lab/** text eol=lf' to CairnCommons/.gitattributes with a comment citing this ticket; the merge-driver line stays.

D2: the proof finds the commons through cairn.tools.artifact roots() (falling back to ~/dev/src/CairnCommons), runs git with GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and a scratch HOME so the box's config cannot steer it, one tooth per clause, PROVES keys 1..3.

measured.saw: 98 of 131 lab files stat-dirty with an empty diff after a recompile on yoga (core.autocrlf=true)
measured.how: the orchestrator's live fire of 2dda7060d84e, git status and git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol, relayed

measured.saw: scratch repo, autocrlf=true: without the attribute a CRLF checkout rewritten LF reads ' M'; with 'lab/** text eol=lf' it checks out LF and reads clean
measured.how: git init in the scratchpad on akiendelllinux, od -c and git status --porcelain

measured.saw: CairnCommons/.gitattributes on origin/main holds only the journal merge-driver line; lab index 131/131 i/lf
measured.how: git show origin/main:.gitattributes; git ls-files --eol intentions-congruency-lab
